import java.util.*;

/** Compiles the production AlphaFilesPlugin.storageQuery body over closed ports, and prints whether
 * each answer says it was cut short. */
public class AlphaFileQueryTest {
 static final class JSArray {
  final List<Object> rows=new ArrayList<>();
  JSArray put(Object row){rows.add(row);return this;}
  int length(){return rows.size();}
 }
 static final class JSObject {
  final Map<String,Object> values=new TreeMap<>();
  void put(String key,Object value){values.put(key,value);}
  @Override public String toString(){Object rows=values.get("entries");return "entries="+(rows instanceof JSArray?((JSArray)rows).length():"-")+";truncated="+values.getOrDefault("truncated","-")+";";}
 }
 static final class PluginCall {
  final boolean folders;JSObject result;
  PluginCall(boolean folders){this.folders=folders;}
  Double getDouble(String key){return null;}
  Boolean getBoolean(String key,Boolean fallback){return "folders".equals(key)?folders:fallback;}
  String getString(String key){return null;}
  String getString(String key,String fallback){return fallback;}
 }
 static final class ContentResolver {}
 static final class StorageBrowser {
  static final int WALK_MAX=10000;
  static final class Row {}
  final int found;
  StorageBrowser(int found){this.found=found;}
  List<Row> folders(String folder,String text,long since,long until,int max,int walk){List<Row> out=new ArrayList<>();for(int i=0;i<Math.min(found,max);i++)out.add(new Row());return out;}
 }
 static final class StorageCatalog {
  static final int QUERY_MAX=500;
  static int found;
  static JSObject queryPage(ContentResolver resolver,String text,String mimePrefix,boolean documents,String folder,long from,long to){
   JSArray entries=new JSArray();
   for(int i=0;i<Math.min(found,QUERY_MAX);i++)entries.put(i);
   JSObject page=new JSObject();
   page.put("entries",entries);
   page.put("truncated",found<0||found>QUERY_MAX);
   return page;
  }
 }
 private @interface PluginMethod {}
 private interface StorageWork {JSObject run(StorageBrowser browser)throws Exception;}
 private final int found;
 AlphaFileQueryTest(int found){this.found=found;StorageCatalog.found=found;}
 private void storage(PluginCall call,StorageWork work){try{call.result=work.run(primaryBrowser());}catch(Exception error){throw new AssertionError(error);}}
 private StorageBrowser primaryBrowser(){return new StorageBrowser(found);}
 private ContentResolver resolver(){return new ContentResolver();}
 private Object row(StorageBrowser.Row row){return row;}
 /* production query */
 public static void main(String[] args){
  for(int found:new int[]{-1,0,3,499,500,501,900})for(boolean folders:new boolean[]{false,true}){
   PluginCall call=new PluginCall(folders);new AlphaFileQueryTest(found).storageQuery(call);
   System.out.println((folders?"folders":"files")+" found="+found+": "+call.result);
  }
 }
}
